findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. Terraform state, plans, and Lambda configuration readers may expose these credentials, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if they are valid.
The function uses the deprecated and unsupported nodejs12.x runtime. Unsupported runtimes no longer receive security updates, leaving the function exposed to known runtime vulnerabilities.
